entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David... I, uh, I need to return something. I bought this Aero Race Jersey a while back, and I'm just so disappointed.

I'm sorry to hear you're disappointed. I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue with the fit?

It's the fit. I guess it's the wrong size. I finally tried it on for a big ride and it's just so uncomfortably tight. I couldn't even zip it up all the way. I've been a loyal customer for years, and this has never happened.
I understand. Getting the right fit is crucial for performance. Let me pull up your order history. Can you confirm the email address on your account?
Yes, it's customer@email.com. I was hoping I could just do an exchange for a larger size, but honestly, with the holidays coming up... I really needed this money back. It's just been a tough month.
Okay, I see the order here. It looks like the Aero Race Jersey was delivered about 62 days ago. Let me just check our policy for you.
Oh... 62 days? I didn't realize it had been that long. I really hope that's not a problem. I feel so bad about this.
Not a problem at all. I have good news. For a standard item like this jersey, VeloFit has a 90-day return window. You are well within that period.
Oh, really? So I can return it for a full refund? That is such a relief, thank you!

Yes, absolutely. Since it was the wrong size and too tight, we can definitely process this as a standard return. I am emailing you a pre-paid return label right now. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the jersey, we'll issue the full refund to your original payment method.
Wow, David, you have no idea how much this helps. Thank you so much for being so understanding.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that was it. You've been wonderful. Thanks again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
